The 'AJC Corporate Development Investment Fund' does VC secondaries (acquiring unlisted shares, bulk-sold securities and LP interests to provide liquidity to the venture secondary market); the 'Succession' funds do business-succession buyouts of small/mid-caps.

summary.en: AJ Capital (est. 2018) is a 50/50 JV of Aozora Bank and Japan Asia Investment (JAIC). Its 'AJC Corporate Development Investment Fund' (¥1.001B) does VC secondaries — buying unlisted shares, bulk-sold securities and LP interests to provide venture-secondary liquidity — alongside Succession 1 (¥3.0B) and Succession 2 (¥5.101B) business-succession funds; ~¥9.1B total AUM.
summary.local: AJキャピタル（2018年設立）はあおぞら銀行と日本アジア投資（JAIC）の50/50JV。『AJC企業育成投資事業有限責任組合』（10.01億円）でVCセカンダリー（非上場株式・バルクセール証券・LP持分の譲受によりベンチャーセカンダリーへ流動性提供）を、サクセッション1号（30億円）・2号（51.01億円）で事業承継投資を実施。運用総額約91億円。

name.local: アント・キャピタル・パートナーズ株式会社

strategy.thesis: Pioneer of fund-stake secondaries in Japan: acquires LP interests in VC/buyout funds and runs GP-led fund restructurings; claims to operate Japan's largest fund-equity secondary fund (fund-equity ops via subsidiary Bee Alternatives since 2021). Also does growth/buyout direct investing.

summary.en: Ant Capital Partners (est. Oct 2000, Tokyo; JV origin of Nikko Principal Investments and UK Antfactory) pioneered Japan's first comprehensive secondary investment fund and runs what it calls the country's largest fund-equity secondary fund — acquiring LP stakes in VC/buyout funds and leading GP-led restructurings (fund-equity ops via subsidiary Bee Alternatives since Aug 2021). Also does direct growth/buyout investing.
summary.local: アント・キャピタル・パートナーズ（2000年10月設立・東京、日興プリンシパル・インベストメンツと英アントファクトリーのJV起源）は、日本初の本格的セカンダリー投資ファンドを組成した先駆者で、国内最大級のファンド持分セカンダリー（VC/バイアウトファンドのLP持分譲受・GP主導再編）を運営。ファンド持分業務は2021年8月よりBee Alternativesで実施。グロース/バイアウトの直接投資も行う。

strategy.thesis: GREE's fund-of-funds program investing as an LP into independent venture capital funds across seed/later/overseas. Operated by Gree Ventures with Gree Capital Management as the 100%-owned LP investor.

summary.en: GREE's fund-of-funds program: 'GREE LP Fund JP1号' (up to ¥12.0B, July 2022) invests as an LP into independent domestic VC funds across seed/later/overseas, and 'GREE LP Fund US I, LP' (~$52.75M, 2022) targets US VCs. Operated by Gree Ventures, with Gree Capital Management (100% Gree-owned) as the LP investor.
